message.content:
I’m sorry, but the function I can use to search for hotels only accepts the following amenities: “Breakfast”, “Fitness Centre”, “Free Wi‑Fi”, and “Parking”. It doesn’t allow me to specify “Vegetarian Meals” or “Spa Services” directly.

Would you like me to search for hotels in New York that offer “Breakfast” and/or “Fitness Centre” (and/or “Free Wi‑Fi” or “Parking”), and then I can manually look for options that also provide vegetarian meals and spa services?
